_comment: Shared Claude Code config baseline for this repo. .claude/settings.json is gitignored (machine-local + OS-specific hook commands), so deny-lists and standard env can't propagate to fresh clones. This committed template carries the OS-agnostic, clearly-shareable parts; `python scripts/setup_claude_settings.py --apply` merges them into your local .claude/settings.json without clobbering local keys. It carried two opt-in hooks (ruff_autofix_on_write, session_reflection_nudge) until the 2026-08-25 harness reset deleted them -- that wiring is also why they looked orphaned when only settings.json was grepped. Any hook added here must also be findable from settings.json, or the orphan check in docs/audits/2026-08-25-harness-reset-baseline.md lies.
